name: Zendesk → DevRev migration POC
description: Parallel-run DevRev environment seeded for a Zendesk customer. Zendesk 'brands' and 'ticket forms' map to DevRev parts. Auto-detects Zendesk CSV exports (lowercase id/requester/assignee headers).

ui_guidance.title: Migrating Zendesk Help Center articles
steps: Export Help Center articles from Zendesk via the Help Center API or the Admin export tool.
Convert the export to a CSV with at minimum 'title' and 'body' columns (Markdown body is fine — DevRev articles accept Markdown).
Re-run `dia plan` and `dia apply` to ingest.

ui_guidance.title: Zendesk Brand → DevRev Part mapping
steps: If your Zendesk org uses multiple Brands, model each Brand as a top-level capability under the Platform product.
Each Brand's ticket forms become features under that capability.
Adjust the parts hierarchy in this blueprint to mirror your Brand structure before applying.

ui_guidance.title: Importing your real Zendesk export
steps: Export tickets from Zendesk Admin → Manage → Reports → Export.
Drop the CSV next to this blueprint and add a `csv` entry: `{ "path": "./zd-tickets.csv", "entity": "tickets" }`.
The agent auto-detects Zendesk headers (id, requester, assignee, group, priority) and applies the column map automatically.
